beats.say: Market swinging hard? The traders who last aren't faster. They have rules.
beats.cap: Market swinging hard? The traders who last aren't faster. They have rules.
beats.sub: to stay disciplined when it gets loud

beats.say: Rule one. No plan, no trade. Write your entry, exit and size before you click.
beats.cap: Rule #1: no plan, no trade. Write your entry, exit and size before you click.

beats.say: Rule two. Risk a small, fixed slice per trade. For example, one percent of your account.
beats.cap: Rule #2: risk a small, fixed slice per trade. Example: 1% of your account.

items.n: example limit · you set your own

beats.say: Rule three. A daily loss limit. Hit it, and you're done until tomorrow.
beats.cap: Rule #3: a daily loss limit. Hit it, and you're done until tomorrow.

beats.say: Rule four. No revenge trades. After three losses, step away. After a big win, keep the same size.
beats.cap: Rule #4: no revenge trades. After 3 losses, step away. After a big win, keep the same size.

beats.say: And remember: no setup means no trade. Sitting out is a decision too.
beats.cap: And remember: no setup means no trade. Sitting out is a decision too.
beats.text: No setup? Doing nothing is a decision.

title: 4 rules to stay disciplined when the market gets wild
caption:
market swinging hard? 🌊 the traders who last aren't faster, they have rules: plan first, small fixed risk per trade, a daily stop, no revenge trades. examples only, set your own limits. not financial advice. which rule do you break the most? 👇
